abilities.effect: The vine sprays a hail of acidic barbs in a 10-foot emanation. Any creature in the area takes 4d10+18 acid damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also blinded for 1 minute.
abilities.name: Barb Spray
abilities.trigger: A creature enters an area containing snake’s mane or the snake’s mane takes damage

hazard.description: A tangle of feathery green vines appears innocuous but fires a spray of acidic barbs at anything that disturbs it.
hazard.disable: Disable DC 27 Nature (expert) to strip the barbs from the vines, rendering them harmless, or DC 30 Stealth (trained) to move through the snake’s mane without disturbing it
hazard.name: Snake's Mane
hazard.reset: 1 hour, as the vine grows a new set of barbs

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to discern the snake’s mane from the surrounding vegetation

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
